## Hand-built in Phase 3

### P0 foundation

- `internal/store/store.go` — pure-Go SQLite (`modernc.org/sqlite`) layer with 5 tables: `search_analytics_rows`, `sites_snapshots`, `sitemaps_snapshots`, `url_inspections`, `sync_runs`. Indexes on `(site_url, date)`, `(site_url, query)`, `(site_url, page)`, `(site_url, page_url, inspected_at DESC)`. Schema is idempotent.
- `internal/store/store_test.go` — open + migrate, idempotent upsert, sites/sitemap snapshot, inspection-history preservation.
- `internal/cli/sync.go` — `sync` command. Pulls search-analytics rows (date × query × page × country × device, paginated up to 250k rows per site) plus sites + sitemaps snapshots. `--backfill Nd|Nw|Nm` with 480-day cap. Honors GSC's ~3-day finalization lag.
- `internal/cli/transcendence.go` — shared helpers for the 11 novel commands: `commonFlags` binder (--site/--window/--db), date-range arithmetic, store opener, empty-store sentinel envelope, generic `rowsToMaps`.

### P1 absorbs (match Bin-Huang/ahonn/AminForou; back with our store)

- `quickwins` — ahonn-shape detectQuickWins, but reads from local store
- `compare` — period-over-period for any of {query, page, country, device}, no API re-query
- `inspect-batch` — file/stdin URL list, NDJSON streaming, `--persist` flag writes each result to `url_inspections` so coverage-drift / triage have data

### P2 transcendence (11 commands no other GSC tool ships)

| Command | Backing | One-liner |
|---|---|---|
| `book` | UNION across all sites + window-vs-window delta + per-site rollup | Cross-property mover board |
| `cannibalize` | `GROUP BY (site, query) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT page) > 1` | Same-site SERP competition |
| `decay` | Linear-fit slope per query over daily rows | Gradual ranking erosion |
| `coverage-drift` | Diff last-2 url_inspections per page on coverage/canonical/last-crawl | Silent deindex catch |
| `opportunity` | Quick-wins joined to prior daily snapshots for entry-date | New vs chronic distinction |
| `momentum` | Recent vs trailing baseline, both directions | Rising stars + collapsing pages |
| `new-queries` | Anti-join `LEFT JOIN prior WHERE prior IS NULL`, --lost inverts | "What's new since last visit" |
| `triage` | Non-INDEXED url_inspections × last-30-day impressions | Fix broken-but-trafficked first |
| `territory` | (query × country × device) share-shift across windows | "Why did our US traffic drop" |
| `appearance` | searchAppearance dimension across windows from stored snapshots | Lost-snippet detection |
| `sitemap-health` | Latest vs prior sitemap snapshot delta | New errors / indexed-ratio drops |

### Tests

- `store_test.go`: 3 tests covering open+migrate, idempotent upsert, history preservation
- `novel_analytics_test.go`: 5 tests covering parseWindow, linearFit (downward + flat), splitNonEmpty, buildGroupKey, sanitizeFloat

## Intentionally deferred

- **Indexing API trigger** (`urls.publish` for re-crawl) — separate Google API + scope. v2.
- **HTML/title scraping** — out of brief scope.
- **GA4 / Bing Webmaster join** — out of v1 scope.
- **GraphQL surface** — N/A (REST).
- **`searchAppearance`-only sync path** — `sync` writes only the canonical 5-dimension breakdown. The `appearance` command queries the same store; if no `searchAppearance` rows exist (because the user hasn't run a separate appearance-only sync), the command emits an explanatory empty envelope rather than synthesizing data.

## Generator limitations encountered

- Generator did not emit a `store/` package or `sync` command for this CLI. The brief's transcendence layer requires persistent data; the generator's small-API branch (~10 endpoints) skipped store scaffolding. This is a generator gap worth noting in the retro: any CLI whose narrative claims a "local SQLite store" should get a baseline store scaffold even when endpoint count is small.
- 10 global Google query params (`access_token`, `alt`, `callback`, `fields`, `key`, `oauth_token`, `prettyPrint`, `quotaUser`, `uploadType`, `upload_protocol`) were correctly filtered.
